app.name: Suspended Tickets Triage Center
app.short_description: Triage, recover, and delete suspended tickets with analytics and caching.
app.long_description: A powerful triage center for Zendesk suspended tickets. Features include bulk recovery and deletion, trend charts, IndexedDB caching for fast loading, search and filtering, virtual scrolling for large datasets, and a 30-day action audit log.
app.installation_instructions: Install the app from the Zendesk Marketplace or upload the ZIP package via Zendesk Admin. No additional configuration is required — the app uses your existing Zendesk authentication.
